summary.text: Tristan Rader is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 13 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served as an at-large council member in Lakewood, Ohio.

paragraphs.text: Tristan Rader was born in Cleveland, Ohio.
He earned an associate degree from Lorain County Community College in 2011, a bachelor's degree from Kent State University in 2013, and a graduate degree from Cleveland State University in 2015.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a program director and, as of 2024, serving as an at-large council member in Lakewood, Ohio.
Rader assumed office in the Ohio House on January 1, 2025, and serves on the Commerce and Labor, Natural Resources, and Government Oversight committees.
He was unopposed in the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Billy Fronimo in the general election.
